title: Suske and Wiske and the lost doll.
lines: Suske is a boy with black hair.
Wiske is a girl with blond hair and a big white bow.
She's naughty and she loves to laugh.
To school, to bed and on trips.
Suske and Wiske live with Aunt Sidonia.
Aunt Sidonia is tall and thin.
She takes very good care of them.
One sunny Saturday Aunt Sidonia says: We're going to the seaside!
She takes her bucket and spade.
They take the train to the coast.
He's bald and he thinks he knows everything.
Jerom is the strongest man in the world.
He can lift a whole tree.
Suske and Wiske build a sandcastle.
A really big sandcastle with towers and a moat.
Schanulleke sits on top of the highest tower.
She's the princess of the castle, says Wiske.
Then they go swimming in the sea.
After swimming they eat an ice cream.
Then Wiske wants to look at her doll.
The waves have washed the castle away.
Suske puts an arm around her.
Leave it to me, he says.
Jerom looks out over the sea.
I can see something red in the water!
Far away something is floating on the waves.
But she's floating further and further away.
He's so strong that the waves move aside.
He very carefully picks up the doll.
And he swims back to the beach.
She hugs the wet doll tight.
Aunt Sidonia dries Schanulleke with a towel.
She lays her in the sun.
The little red dress gets dry and warm again.
Suske says: Now let's build a new castle.
But this time further away from the sea.
They build a castle even bigger than the first one.
Jerom carries buckets full of sand.
Aunt Sidonia decorates it with little shells.
But this time Wiske holds on to her tightly.
In the evening they're on the train home.
Wiske sleeps with her head on Suske's shoulder.
And in her arms Schanulleke is sleeping.
And so another lovely Suske and Wiske story comes to an end.
